groups.manual: These environments live on the Linux analysis site. Prepare the commands here with `python3.12 scripts/setup/site_installation.py --plan --linux-root /path/to/ravel/on/the/site`, or run `bash scripts/setup/install.sh --profile site` on the site itself.

qualification.basis: Testers qualify this group on their own Linux analysis facility with the recorded procedure. No such run is recorded here and none is claimed; the group does not run on the reference Mac.
qualification.procedure: On the Linux analysis facility, in the RAVEL checkout, run `bash scripts/setup/install.sh --profile site --prefix /path/to/work/area/ravel-tools` and then `.venv/bin/ravel doctor --group site-root-wms`. It passes when the doctor reports site-analysis-python, site-wms-python and site-snakemake ready, prints `Everything selected is ready.` and exits with status 0.

refusal_classes.title: Loop decays of a generated spectrum
refusal_classes.refused: Decay widths of a generated spectrum need loop functions from Collier or LoopTools.
refusal_classes.why: The installer builds neither library and the spectrum route refuses decays unless the caller binds an explicit Collier or LoopTools build.
refusal_classes.would_make_it_possible: An installer entry in the spectrum group that builds Collier (owner default) at a pinned source, a doctor check for its libraries, and a spectrum run that binds them.

refusal_classes.title: EasyScan cell T8: singlet grid with micrOMEGAs 7.1
refusal_classes.why: micrOMEGAs is not installed by any group; the cell cannot run from an installed toolchain.
refusal_classes.would_make_it_possible: A pinned micrOMEGAs 7.1 source fetch and build in the easyscan group (source licence terms confirmed by the owner) and a doctor check for its binary.

refusal_classes.title: EasyScan cell T9: 17-parameter MSSM chain
refusal_classes.refused: The SUSY-HIT, FeynHiggs, HiggsBounds and GM2Calc chain, serial MCMC.
refusal_classes.why: SUSY-HIT, FeynHiggs and HiggsBounds are not installed by any group.
refusal_classes.would_make_it_possible: Pinned source fetches and builds of SUSY-HIT, FeynHiggs and HiggsBounds in the easyscan group, with doctor checks for each binary.

refusal_classes.title: EasyScan cell T10: MSSM chain, serial prior trials
refusal_classes.refused: The same MSSM chain as T9.

refusal_classes.title: EasyScan cell T11: MSSM chain, two isolated workers
